question: Cheapest way to ‚wire‚ money in an Australian bank account to a person in England, while I'm in Laos?

answers: If you trust the other party, an international bank wire would be the quickest, and easiest option. It is the standard way to pay for something overseas. Most Banks allow to make an international transfer. As the amount is small, there is no paperwork required. Depending what country you are from, there may be better alternatives to transfer money internationally. My current favorite service for this kind of transfer is Transferwise. The fees are quite low when compared to the 2.5-3% by high-street banks for currency conversion, to which you need to add the international wire transfer fee. Also take a look at companies like UK Forex for transferring funds internationally.
